title: Wave-02 Evidence Credibility Audit and Native Commit Pipeline Discovery

claims.statement: 18 Personal Defense Fields: 32-bit Word 1 default 0x00280000 and 11-bit Word 2 mask 0x7FF are hard binary facts, but individual subfield bit-allocation is a deduced layout from UI ordering, not verified by micro-setters.
instructions: 0x14652c0: mov rax, [rdx]; mov [rcx], rax; mov edx, [rdx+8]; mov [rcx+8], edx
claims.falsification_note: No individual 2-bit or 3-bit micro-setter exists; 12 bytes are copied via 2 instructions, so it is not a hardware atomic store.

claims.statement: Playbook 68 Slots: 360-byte PLAYBOOKDATA and 68-slot limit are hard binary facts (0x7aa584: cmp eax, 0x44; 0x149ae80 reads assigned play count at [PlaybookManager+0x7fc]), while the 30/20/10/8 division is gameplay UI organization.
claims.falsification_note: The loop does not contain four separate partition checks; 68 is the global capacity threshold.

claims.statement: Gameplan Native Commit Pipeline: UI commit at 0x7a7aab sets [rbx]=1 (customized flag), sets [r15+4]=1 (dirty flag), packs 880-byte gameplan into stack buffer, and calls 0x1414af790 which dispatches task 0xf7ba8674 via 0x1414c1060.
claims.falsification_note: In-memory changes take effect immediately on Gameplan struct; 0x14af790 is required only to synchronize running live simulation workers.
